description.zh: 不依赖 git 的项目快照管理：文件级变更流水、多挂载点、.gitignore 完整语法、跨版本回滚/fork。数据存于 {插件根}/snapshot/{ProjectID}/（manifest.json + SQLite data.db），全部走 Java bridge 与 Tools.Files，不依赖终端。
description.en: Git-free project snapshot management: file-level change streams, multi-mount, full .gitignore syntax, cross-version rollback/fork. Data lives in {pluginRoot}/snapshot/{ProjectID}/ (manifest.json + SQLite data.db), powered by Java bridge and Tools.Files only - no terminal required.

description.zh: init / manage / commit / show / list / diff / ChangeCommitNode / PullFromHistory / Rollback 九个快照工具。
description.en: Nine snapshot tools: init / manage / commit / show / list / diff / ChangeCommitNode / PullFromHistory / Rollback.
